description: Get a detailed financial summary for a specific vendor. Returns authoritative net/gross/tax totals in the user's primary currency with "comparable: true", individual invoice list (each with explicit "currency", "comparable", and "converted_to_primary" fields), and foreign currency totals marked with "comparable: false". converted_to_primary is null when no conversion data exists, or { amount, currency, source } when bank reconciliation has recorded actual settlement amounts. Includes a top-level "currency_warning". Totals are authoritative and more reliable than manually summing query_invoices results. Requires the Start or Business plan.

vendor.description: Vendor name to look up (case-insensitive partial match)

name: get_vendor_summary
